scenes.headline: What a GGUF coder release contains, read from its headers
scenes.sub: Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B: a dynamic quant recipe, and a chat template.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sprite! Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B ships as nine GGUF files. Their headers describe everything inside, so let's read them.

scenes.label: What's in the files
scenes.text: Tiel-Coder is Ornith-1.5's weights, cut into nine tiers by an importance-driven recipe. The only new artefact is a 29,157-character chat template.
scenes.say: Tiel-Coder is Ornith-1.5's weights, cut into nine tiers by an importance-driven recipe. The one new thing isn't a weight at all. It's a chat template.

steps.say: A token climbs forty blocks. Thirty use linear attention, ten use full attention, and each routes it to eight of two hundred fifty-six experts.
The routed experts are ninety-three percent of the parameters. In this tier, they are the only part cut to about four bits.
Attention, the shared expert and the output head stay at eight and a half bits. The router is never quantized at all.

steps.note: experts 4.53 bits, everything else 8.50: the file averages 5.161
steps.say: So the tier called four-bit averages five point one six bits a weight. The same few blocks get promoted in tier after tier.

scenes.label: of KV cache per token: only 10 of 40 blocks do full attention
scenes.note: the other 30 hold a fixed recurrent state
scenes.say: And the cache is tiny: twenty kilobytes per token, because only ten of the forty blocks do full attention. The rest keep a fixed state.

scenes.title: What is inherited, and what is new

left.title: The weights
items: An importance matrix from 3,000 chunks of 512 tokens
left.say: The weights are Ornith-1.5's, re-quantized against an importance matrix the author measured and shipped.

right.title: The chat template
items: A terse system prompt, on by default
right.say: The template is new: twenty-nine thousand characters of Jinja, carrying a terse system prompt that's on by default.

scenes.title: MMLU-Pro, the card's control arm
scenes.say: The card's control proves it. Same quant, Ornith's template: same score as Ornith. The terse prompt costs four point three points, for twenty percent shorter answers.

scenes.text: Read the template of any model you deploy: here the only new artefact is a system prompt inside the GGUF.
scenes.mark: a system prompt inside the GGUF

recap: Experts near 4 bits, everything else near 8.5
Only 10 of 40 blocks keep a KV cache
The new part is a Jinja system prompt
scenes.say: To recap: four-bit experts, a tiny cache, and a new prompt riding inside the file.
